run_compression_eval: run a prompt compression evaluation benchmark comparing baseline vs compressed model performance on coding tasks
run_eval_with_model: run the compression eval harness with a specific model like gpt-4o and a subset of problems
run_eval_with_padding: run the compression eval with a custom padding factor to inject more distractor context snippets
run_eval_with_embedding: run the compression eval with an embedding model for semantic scoring instead of BM25 only
run_eval_multiple_runs: run the compression eval harness with multiple runs per mode for statistical reliability
